notes.title: 1.3.7 is LIVE
notes.content:
[i]Almost 2 years ago we Announced.
A year ago we released.
...and we're still going![/i]

It’s been one truly spectacular year. We’ve been working on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9VzkGwz6-HA]console versions of Mechanicus[/url] as you may or may not already know. Going a little furth back we’ve also had the wonderful and well-received [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/673880/partnerevents/view/1588004341488409368]Augment Update[/url] that gave us all so much more choice! Lastly, let us not forget the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049290/Warhammer_40000_Mechanicus__Heretek/]Heretek DLC[/url] that was launched during the summer. It was a real pleasure to be able to craft new IP in a very unique opportunity and share that with you guys.

Now for what we’re really here for, the update...

[h1]The Omnissiah's will has solved the following issues:[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed: Secutor Command fire ability		
[*] Fixed: Random Music during battles							
[*] Fixed: Victory ending when losing the last DLC mission					
[*] Fixed: Heretek blackscreen issue
[*] Fixed: Necron Lord never ends his turn after creating walls
[*] Fixed: New Troops units not showing in Cohort screen
[*] Fixed: Barrier after loading a save
[*] Fixed: Deathmark can shoot a Tech-Priest with the Cog Occultaris buff			
[*] Fixed: Angered Spirit buff doesn't stack with Exploritor and Dominus
[*] Fixed: Litany of Life showing up twice in tech view
[/list]

Check out all the Patch notes, future, current or past in this ultimate [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1v10TeALecgsx9OnovvLKuahRLN3AKQGjYc_gv-8D1fQ/edit?usp=sharing]ChangeLog[/url]

notes.title: Skulls for the Skull Throne 3 + 1.2.4 - Augment Update
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/sale/skulls/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32135886/9faa3824e6ed85642dc7f6b6127ab4c6ed714f70.jpg[/img] [/url]
Skulls for the Skull Throne is back and Mechanicus is proud to be taking part with a massive 35% discount on both the special Omnissiah Edition as well as the standard base game. 

The festival of Warhammer Gaming continues over the weekend and along with the savings, players can also take advantage of the brand new, and totally free, update to the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32135886/9b124224fd9e5698a780d621d4fcb1b9f5d5c0f1.png[/img]

[h1]Augment Update = LIVE[/h1]
After three weeks of public beta testing the Augment Update is now live!
Over those weeks we’ve been able to tweak the numbers to get the experience just right. With the help of the community (thanks guys you’re the best!) we’ve also been able to iron out the experience.

[h1]How much is the Augment Update?[/h1]
Free! The whole thing is free of charge!

[h1]What’s in the Augment Update[/h1]
Lets just rehash what we said [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/673880/discussions/0/1678064284152184946/?tscn=1557350032]three weeks ago[/url].
There's a lot! Here's a really brief summary;
[list][*]IronMan Mode
[*]Permadeath
[*]Difficulty settings
[*]A huge array of Customisation option for those difficulty settings
[*]Exploration has been polished
[*]Tons of polish to UI elements, enough to make a servo-skull weep sacred oils
[*]Fonts are cleaner
[*]Balance changes for a couple of things
[*]Turkish localisation added!
[/list]

Check out all the Patch notes, future, current or past in this ultimate [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1v10TeALecgsx9OnovvLKuahRLN3AKQGjYc_gv-8D1fQ/edit?usp=sharing]ChangeLog[/url]


[h1]But I want to play Mechanicus Classic[/h1]
We understand that some people don’t like change. That’s understandable, certainly from my personal point of view, us brits can be traditional! Rambling aside, you can still access [b]Mechanicus Classic[/b] through the steam beta branch titled [i]mechanicus-classic – 1.1.4 – pre-Augment Update[/i]. You can find out how to do this here
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1571440010
The [i]mechanicus-classic[/i] branch will stay as 1.1.4 forever. This is to avoid any issues should saved games not be backwards compatible for whatever reason, or you’re a huge fan of vanilla.

[h1]Heretek Expansion is available for wishlisting![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049290/Warhammer_40000_Mechanicus__Heretek/

Heretek is the expansion to the critically acclaimed tactical turn-based Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus. Opening a whole new plot line, Heretek exposes the dark underbelly of the Adeptus Mechanicus faction like never before. Brand new narrative events have been handcrafted once again by Ben Counter, allowing players to uncover what has brought civil unrest to The Caestus Metalican during its campaign at Silva Tenebris. Take on frighteningly familiar foes, a cohort of heretek Tech-Priests that have changed their beliefs and forsaken the name of the Omnissiah. Can you, Magos Dominus Faustinius manage both an assault on the Necrons while being corrupted from within?

[b]Features[/b]
[list][*] New Discipline to utilise: Unlock the Xenarite. A discipline that is specialised in using xenotech, a largely forbidden practice for those that follow the Omnissiah! Plus all new augments for you to customise the appearance of your Tech-Priest.
[*] 5 new missions: Experience five new missions based in the Ark Mechanicus, each with a new delivery system for narrative. The choices you make will impact the battle for that mission.
[*] New weapons to discover: Xeno-altered weapons open up devastating possibilities, coupled with support tech that opens up new play styles.
[*] Two new Troops to command: Sicarian Infiltrators and Ruststalkers are now available to unlock. Pass through Necron and Heretek limbs alike with the Transonic Blades of the Ruststalker or take the stealthy route with the Infiltrators and spring an unexpected ambush.
[*] New but familiar enemies to face: Face your fellow brother Tech-Priests in an internal conflict over Necron xenotech while also holding back the wakening of the Necrons.
[*] New mission environment: Experience combat inside an Ark Mechanicus for the first time in Warhammer 40,000 history.
[/list]

notes.title: Open Beta - future update - all welcome!
notes.content:
[i]Let's keep this short, 
but informative,
and awesome.

We have an Open Beta!
and here's the run down.[/i]

Oh, how busy we have been!
We know we've been silent recently, but all for good reason! We've put our heads down focusing on some things we're not able to announce right now, some things that a few people have discovered over on our Discord channel, and finally, what we're all here for, the purpose of this post, the Augment Update!!!

Now, this isn't the official release, but it's no less important!
This is access to the update before the official release. You can access the update on our PTR beta branch, which you can find out how to join here https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1571440010

[h1]What are the key points of the update[/h1]
There's a lot! So here's a really brief summary;
[list][*]IronMan Mode
[*]Permadeath
[*]Difficulty settings
[*]A huge array of Customisation option for those difficulty settings
[*]Exploration has been polished
[*]Tons of polish to UI elements, enough to make a servo-skull weep sacred oils
[*]Fonts are cleaner
[*]Balance changes for a couple of things
[*]Turkish localisation added!
[/list]

Now, this is a really brief list! Check out all the Patch notes, future, current or past in this ultimate [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1v10TeALecgsx9OnovvLKuahRLN3AKQGjYc_gv-8D1fQ/edit?usp=sharing]ChangeLog[/url]

We'd really appreciate any feedback on this build, the more the merrier! If you do please make sure you put [b]1.2.0 beta[/b] into your posts either here or on Discord.

[h1]I have an idea for a tickbox or modifier, how do I share this[/h1]
Well, now we've worked hard at the structure of the Customisable Difficulty while also finding meaningful options for you guys to play with, we want to hear what you have to say!

Please post your ideas in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/673880/discussions/4/]Customise Difficulty suggestions[/url] sub-forum so that we can easily identify them for consideration. Please note not all idea are possible. We will do what we can.

[h1]I'm going to wait for final release[/h1]
Just so you know your saves for the beta will be able to carry over to release ;)
But if you're not a beta person that's fine, we will push this build live sometime in the future. 
Now if you're currently in a game, we've made a branch called [b]Mechanicus-Classic[/b] for all those that want no disruption from this update.

The Mechanicus-Classic branch will stay as 1.1.4 (the current version) forever. This is to avoid any issues should saved games not be backwards compatible for whatever reason.

-------------------------------

The original post can be found here https://steamcommunity.com/app/673880/discussions/0/1678064284152184946/

notes.title: 1.1.3 + Mac OS X + Linux + Unity Engine
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AI1UjT7.gif[/img]
[h1]Mac OS X and Linux[/h1]
Great news! Mechanicus is now fully supporting MacOS and Linux.

[h1]Unity Engine update[/h1]
Not groundbreaking, but if it's better... then it can't be worse, right?

[h1]Patch 1.1.3 - the clean up servitor[/h1]
There have been some none critical bugs just scrapping-up our precious code for some time now. It's probably fair to say that this patch deals with a fair share of those issues.

As you may or may not know (still new fans every day ːsteamhappyː) you can find all Patch notes in our [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1v10TeALecgsx9OnovvLKuahRLN3AKQGjYc_gv-8D1fQ/edit?usp=sharing]ChangeLog[/url].

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
We'll be really secretive about the details right now, but here's a Necron Skeleton outline for you.
 - An update that will deliver a custom difficulty challenge for all
 - more content! (Troops, a discipline, environment and more)
 - more polishing... because we can!

[h1]Another Thank YOU[/h1]
Thank you all for the kind words you still keep sharing with us. We just can't get over how much you all appreciate the game we have created and we cannot be more satisfied.
:admech::blackstone::poweraxewpn::skitarii::techpriest:

notes.title: PTR - balance patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
[h1]1.0.8[/h1]
With patch 1.0.8 we are now focusing on balancing Mechanicus to have a nicer and smoother difficulty curve. We understand that change can be hard, and as such we have launched 1.0.8 exclusively (for now) on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1571440010]PTR[/url]. We want to give you all enough time to explore the changes and the patch notes.

[i]For more details on 1.0.8 or in fact any previous patch, check out our master [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1v10TeALecgsx9OnovvLKuahRLN3AKQGjYc_gv-8D1fQ/edit?usp=sharing]ChangeLog[/url] [/i]

[h1]When will 1.0.8 go LIVE, and leave PTR?[/h1]
It's possible it may never go live, it might merge with a future patch or go live some time in the future. We cannot say at this point, as balance is a difficult art indeed.

[h1]So was this the hidden message?[/h1]
Not entirely.

[h1]So is this happening?[/h1]
Sure thing! We're also not pleased, but this is just the way things are. We do have a balance patch as you already know, and hope this helps for the week delay.

[h1]What were those last two questions about?[/h1]
Easter eggs

Thank you from myself and the entire Bulwark Studios team




p.s.[spoiler] yes... you probably spotted we didn't post about 1.0.7, it was a thing, and it's currently live. If you weren't aware, our apologies, here's a link https://steamcommunity.com/app/673880/discussions/0/1743353164084350509/ [/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 is LIVE
notes.content:
[h1]Omnissian Glory[/h1]
Just over a week ago today we launched Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus.
Two small patches and now our third. We have servitored day and night to deliver the smoothest Mechanicus experience to date!

[h1]1.0.6[/h1]
With patch 1.0.6 we've resolved the lion’s share of bugs, in what fans have been telling us, "record speed".

For more details on 1.0.6 or in fact any previous patches, we have now created a master list [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1v10TeALecgsx9OnovvLKuahRLN3AKQGjYc_gv-8D1fQ/edit?usp=sharing]ChangeLog[/url] so that we all know everything, ever, just as the Omnissiah had planned.

Here's the Steam Community overview of the patch: https://steamcommunity.com/app/673880/discussions/0/1743352529770498103/

[h1]PTR[/h1]
Lastly over the past 24hrs we've also launched our first PTR. Currently this is now the same build as the CURRENT live build. However going forward when we move into balancing and addition features, this is going to be the place to go to get the latest builds before they go live for the whole world. Want to know more about PTR? Head [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1571440010]here.[/url]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
Lastly thank you so much to everyone that has supported us and have been giving valuable and constructive feedback. With your support we know that we can take Mechanicus from being the greatly loved passion project we’ve created into something so much more.

Thank you from myself and the entire Bulwark Studios team
